integrity: Direct proof from conditional-expectation decomposition, rank-one algebra and sharp Holder duality; finite rational verifier supplements but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-cell sigma-algebras only; real Lp with 1<p<infinity; convergence to constants requires |theta|<1; 1987 full text could not be obtained, so bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: Exact mixing norms and time-reversal obstruction for binary conditional-expectation chains
